themes.problem: 图像质量提升与细节增强
themes.means: 信号处理、滤波器设计、密度分析
themes.effect: 改善图像清晰度和减少伪影

evidence.quote: To ensure sharpness of a picture and improve picture quality by making smoothing of picture data only for relatively flat part of picture density.

To exactly discriminate a character, a photograph, and a dotted area by comparing the variation amount of the maximum value and the minimum value of the difference between the densities of a higher density signal with an original image variable density signal in which character areas and halftone areas are mixed.

To generate a sharp picture without moire from an original picture by generating an unsharpness signal through the averaging processing of picture information and executing contour emphasis processing to the unsharpness signal to generate a sharpness signal and forming a dot picture from the sharpness signal.
